Rebuild the index when search results look wrong or miss entries that you know exist. The command needs a Node build with FTS5 and refuses to run without it. Your entries stay as they are.

## CLI: gournal index rebuild

Drop and recreate the full-text search index. It takes today's backup first, if none exists yet. Run it only when every gournal process uses a Node build with FTS5.

```text
gournal index rebuild
```

## Examples

### CLI

Rebuild the search index. The command prints the number of entries that it indexed.

```console
$ gournal index rebuild
Search index rebuilt: 8 entries.
```
